pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-brown regions with soft, feathered edge gradients. The patches on the lower flank are larger and more elongated, while patches on the neck are smaller and more densely packed with sharper angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate; pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, narrowing between the large lower flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude brush-like silhouette of short, stiff hairs visible along the dorsal neck ridge against the sky.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A cluster of approximately three distinct, circular de-pigmented spots with textural disruption located on the dark patches of the upper shoulder/lower neck area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular, light-colored lesions on the upper shoulder region, indicating localized skin disruption or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible pendulous scrotum at the ventral midline; dark patches exhibit subtle internal tonal variations with lighter central regions.
